## What this changes

<!-- A correction, a new citation, a new pattern proposal, a site fix, etc. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] **Cites a source.** New or changed factual claims carry a citation, ranked by evidence tier (legal/regulatory, evidence-based, or precedent-based). If you couldn't find one, the claim is flagged with `:::unsourced` or `<Citation unsourced />` instead of left uncited.
- [ ] **Matches house style.** Third-person voice for pattern entries, no first-person framing, no words implying certification or guaranteed compliance ("code-approved," "certified"), no reproduced excerpts from source manuals (MUTCD, CROW, etc.), paraphrase and cite instead.
- [ ] **Fits the existing structure.** This is a correction or a new pattern within an existing Functional Classification, not a change to the Functional Classification system, the Pattern ID format, the scale hierarchy, or a core safety rule (like the Local speed cap). If it is the latter, there's a linked issue discussing it first, see [Governance](https://commonwaysystem.org/about/governance/).
